messages:
paula_cs: Morning everyone 1  starting MarlinIQ onboarding thread. Pilot goal: prove SSO + daily export + cost transparency in a 3-week window. Need owners for SSO/SCIM decision, export schema, perf checks, and a short renewal one-pager. Can we confirm owners now?

devin_impl: I can take integration (SSO + export). Quick Q: they asked about SCIM for provisioning later, but pilot only needs SAML. I'll scope SCIM as Phase 2.

kai_eng: I'll own perf and staging. Heads-up: they run occasional large-batch embedding jobs overnight and interactive chat during the day 1. Need concurrent session estimate to size workers.

noor_pm: Product asks for success criteria: (1) SAML login + test users, (2) daily CSV export validated against Snowflake schema, (3) median chat latency <250ms and embeddings p95 <1.8s during a 48h pilot window, (4) cost-per-10k-tokens documented and within negotiated threshold. Exec demo must clearly show unit-cost delta vs incumbent.

sam_renewals: Renewal note: finance will cancel if cost is unpredictable. We should capture baseline spend from their current vendor and run a short cost A/B during Week 1. I'll draft a 1-page executive cost brief.

paula_cs: Proposed owners: Paula = CS lead, Devin = Integration lead, Kai = Eng perf, Noor = PM/customer liaison, Sam = Renewal/exec liaison. OK?

devin_impl: OK. I'll create an "integration checklist" on Confluence: IdP metadata required fields, sample CSV schema, retention & encryption (TLS + AES-256). Ask: do they require signed SAML assertions?

noor_pm: Customer prefers signed assertions. I'll confirm and add to the ticket. Also they want prompt anonymization before we run evals. We'll provide a small sanitize script.

kai_eng: Technical note: some of their workflows send 6-10k token prompts. We'll include a model-variant eval (full vs 4-bit quant) to compare cost & quality. Tagging Optimize for follow-up.

sam_renewals: Good. If quantized output quality is acceptable, we'll show finance a projected savings scenario for Year 1.

paula_cs: Draft timeline (WIP):
```
- Day 0: internal kickoff + owners confirmed
- Week 1: SSO setup (IdP metadata) + baseline traffic capture + quick A/B cost eval
- Week 2: Integration + data export validation + 48h pilot load window
- Week 3: Performance tuning, runbook, exec demo, renewal one-pager and handoff
```

devin_impl: I'll request IdP metadata and sample rows today. Adding daily export cadence (00:30 UTC) to the notes.

kai_eng: I'll spin up a staging route and run two 24h passes: daytime interactive and overnight batch. Need the traffic profile from Noor.

noor_pm: Sending traffic shapes and anonymization instructions in DM. MarlinIQ will return sanitized prompts by EOD tomorrow.

sam_renewals: Action items for today: 1) Devin: Confluence integration checklist + data contract (EOD). 2) Kai: staging perf plan + A/B template. 3) Noor: traffic profile + confirm signed assertions + anonymization plan. 4) Paula: request baseline spend from customer and schedule the internal prep sync. 5) Sam: draft renewal brief template.

cal-bot: Event created: "MarlinIQ Internal Onboard Prep" Tue 9:30am PT 1  calendar invite sent.

paula_cs: Thanks team 389 I'll collate these and run the internal sync before the customer kickoff.

devin_impl: One more flag: export schema must include route tag so finance can map costs. I'll include a "route_id" column in the sample CSV.

kai_eng: Noted. Also adding "token_count" column so we can reconcile per-request cost.

paula_cs: Perfect. Closing actions here and will share Confluence link in the prep meeting invite. :tada:
